name: Kon'ya, Otou-sama ni Dakaremasu...
original_name: 今夜、お義父様に抱かれます…
source: Takeru married his childhood friend, Haruka. His career as a teacher at their old school is going well, and he receives positive feedback from colleagues and students. When he returns home, his beloved wife Haruka greets him with a smile. Takeru feels fulfilled and happy both in his personal and professional life. However, unbeknownst to him, his happiness is threatened by his own father and Haruka's father-in-law, Gouzou. He demands Haruka's body in exchange for helping Takeru out of a difficult situation. Haruka agrees to have a one night stand with Gouzou, on the condition that Takeru never finds out.
